en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-style song; origin otherwise unclear. 'сербез' meaning is my reading; 'џумер' I could not identify with confidence, so I left it as '...'. 'ја посврши' is rendered 'settled it' (the match).

lines.en: It was settled, my dear, it was settled,
careless Mara, Adzhi's daughter.
Her father settled it,
he settled it, he did not ask her

lines.cyr: дали она, џанам, ќе го сака.
lines.lat: dali ona, džanam, ḱe go saka.
lines.en: whether she, my dear, would love him.

lines.cyr: Цел ден оди Мара, цел ден плаче,
lines.lat: Cel den odi Mara, cel den plače,
lines.en: All day Mara walks, all day she weeps,
she wrings her fingers, bitterly curses:
- Father, may you see no good

lines.cyr: што ме такса, не ме праша
lines.lat: što me taksa, ne me praša
lines.en: for promising me, for not asking me

lines.cyr: дали сакам него да го љубам!
lines.lat: dali sakam nego da go ljubam!
lines.en: whether I want to love him!
Didn't you have, father, didn't you have
another, better-looking boy,
that you promised me to Dime,
a drunkard, a gambler,
and a chaser of women, my dear?

lines.cyr: Јас го љубам, џанам, млад Ѓорѓија,
lines.lat: Jas go ljubam, džanam, mlad Ǵorǵija,
lines.en: I love, my dear, young Gjorgija,
he is a ..., a singer of songs.
And by night I will run away,
I will take Gjorgija

lines.cyr: и со него век ќе провекувам.
lines.lat: i so nego vek ḱe provekuvam.
lines.en: and live out my life with him.
